best_direction.angle_title: When solving it alone started hurting the team
best_direction.core_claim: The robotics project is the setting. The essay is about the moment the student's instinct — handling it alone — started costing the team. What changed after that is the real subject.
best_direction.why_this_is_the_real_story: The interesting part is not the technical work. It is the moment the student recognized that solving problems alone was making the team weaker — and changed how they operated.
best_direction.what_it_reveals_about_the_student: It shows that the student can recognize when their own competence is becoming a problem for others — and adjust without waiting to be asked.
best_direction.why_it_beats_the_obvious_angle: An achievement essay focuses on what got built. This version focuses on how the student's role in the team changed — a more specific and less predictable story.
best_direction.main_risk_if_written_poorly: If written as an accomplishment sequence, it loses the pivot that makes the essay meaningful.
best_direction.next_move: Keep the focus on the team moment, not the technical solution. Write the decision where your first approach was not working, then show what you changed and what it produced. The pivot point is the shift from individual performance to relational leadership.

alternatives.what_this_angle_would_focus_on: Execution quality and accomplishment evidence in the same experience.
alternatives.why_it_is_weaker: It can show capability, but it underweights internal change and essay-level tension.
alternatives.failure_mode: Can collapse into an activity summary without a deeper interpretive claim.

alternatives.what_this_angle_would_focus_on: How your actions affected other people and community outcomes.
alternatives.why_it_is_weaker: It carries moral seriousness, but the self-revision arc is less sharply evidenced than the winner.
alternatives.failure_mode: Can become broad values prose if the turning moment is not dramatized.

depth_signals.detected_tension: The tension is between what happened and what it actually changed in you.
depth_signals.obvious_but_weaker_angle: Obvious but weaker angle: problem-solving excellence as a static trait.
depth_signals.essay_opportunity: Frame the essay around the shift from individual performance to relational leadership.
